summary: Ground lookout on the Challis National Forest, Custer County, Idaho: ground cabin c.1939, staffed as a fire detection point; listed as gone. No source read describes the site today.

notes_for_editor: Two sources date the lookout to about 1939 and agree on Challis National Forest and Custer County. The 'gone' status comes from two sources but neither gives a removal date. No source read describes the site today or says whether it is open to the public. The Forest Lookouts page shows 12N-14E-21 under the site name with no label; not used in the story. This is a different record from the Deadwood Lookout near Garden Valley in the Boise National Forest.
